title: About Nohitatu
text: Nohitatu Technologies Private Limited is a software development and SaaS partner specializing in global software delivery, healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical billing, and custom digital products for providers, payers, health-tech, and product teams.

title: Custom & global software development
text: Nohitatu builds custom software, cloud-native SaaS, web apps, and provides application development, maintenance, and support. Delivery uses a cost-effective global/global model with dedicated engineering teams that plug into client roadmaps.

title: Healthcare software, medical billing, RCM
text: Nohitatu specializes in healthcare RCM and medical billing: claims, denials, billing workflows, and automation for operational efficiency. Services suit providers, payers, and health-tech companies.

title: Web, mobile, ERP, and AI
text: Services include web and mobile app development, ERP/enterprise workflows, AI-driven custom software, digital transformation, product modernization, and legacy replacement.

title: Hiring dedicated developers
text: Nohitatu helps clients engage dedicated dedicated developer teams that integrate with existing processes and roadmaps—suitable for scaling product, platform, and enterprise initiatives.
